name: Sleep Ring
description: A score in a ring made of one segment per sleep stage, with a large numeral in the middle and a row per stage below.

props.name: score
props.description: Score out of 100. The ring sweeps that share of a turn; the rest is a pale track.

props.name: stages
props.type: { name: string; minutes: number; color?: string }[]
props.description: Time in each stage. Each takes a segment of the ring and a row below, sized by its share of the night. Colours follow the chart palette unless given.

props.name: rating
props.description: The word above the numeral. Defaults to Excellent from 85, Good from 70, Fair from 50, Poor below.

props.name: formatDuration
props.description: Writes stage durations. Defaults to "1 h 42 m".

props.name: size
props.description: Ring diameter in pixels. Shrinks to fit a narrow card.

props.name: summary
props.description: What the chart shows, for screen readers. Generated when left out.

props.name: action
props.description: A control on the right of the header, such as a PeriodStepper from @/components/miyuki-ui/lib/chart for the week.

props.name: label
props.description: Small muted label at the top of the card.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the card. Also accepts value, delta, caption, note, footer and every other prop of a div.
